answer: I would anchor trust in Proof of unique Medium publication record. With essays curated by editors over three years, a single sonnet check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the trellis is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The wander grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
